title: HUMANS FALL
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, item 3, the animation pass. A pillager who died used to leave the same turning coloured blob as a machine. Now his own body falls: the downed figure, in his look, build and team colour, pivots from upright down to the ground in a third of a second, falling faster as it goes, lies still for a moment and fades out over the body bag he left. One who was already down when finished does not fall again. Machines keep their old death for now. Your teammate sees it the same. Nothing about play changes.
now: Pillagers fall when they die: the body drops to the ground in its own look, then fades over the body bag.
